dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: My era was the one that came after Istoria's. I'd never heard of the dragon that tore open the sky in my time.

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: We were not as wise as those from his era, because the angels no longer bestowed true secrets upon us.

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: After I found out that all our philosophizing, creations, and struggles were all for naught, the only consolation I had was...

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: That Istoria's era wasn't particularly rich or opulent by any measure. Our two eras were comparable in terms of quality of life, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: A philosopher in despair turned competitive hedonist. What a heartbreaking tale.

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: In this sense, Istoria has shown tremendous strength. The pursuit of knowledge and record-keeping are such meaningless behaviors...

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: Yet he still exerts his mind to such ends.
